template.name: Grid Survey Coverage Sweep
template.description: One drone flies a four-corner survey grid at a fixed altitude and photographs the area. Use it when the scenario needs systematic area coverage rather than point inspection.
template.content: Have {drone_name} take off to {random_alt:22:30:1} meters, then fly a rectangular survey grid over the south-west corner ({randx_wp1:120:320:1}, {randy_wp1:420:620:1}), the south-east corner ({randx_wp2:620:820:1}, {randy_wp2:420:620:1}), the north-east corner ({randx_wp3:620:820:1}, {randy_wp3:120:320:1}) and back to the south-west corner, staying at {random_alt:22:30:1} meters the whole time. Take a photo as it reaches every waypoint, including the return over the south-west corner, so four photographs in total, and finish hovering above that last waypoint.
content_aliases: Send {drone_name} up to {random_alt:22:30:1} m and run a four-corner survey grid: ({randx_wp1:120:320:1}, {randy_wp1:420:620:1}) then ({randx_wp2:620:820:1}, {randy_wp2:420:620:1}) then ({randx_wp3:620:820:1}, {randy_wp3:120:320:1}) and close the loop, with a photo at each corner.
{drone_name} should climb to {random_alt:22:30:1} m and sweep the survey rectangle starting at ({randx_wp1:120:320:1}, {randy_wp1:420:620:1}), taking four photos, one per corner.

Coverage task: {drone_name} at {random_alt:22:30:1} m, four waypoints ({randx_wp1:120:320:1}, {randy_wp1:420:620:1}) / ({randx_wp2:620:820:1}, {randy_wp2:420:620:1}) / ({randx_wp3:620:820:1}, {randy_wp3:120:320:1}), four photos, then hover.
